summary.headline: Astrological Codex Entries 267–282
summary.text: Catalog entries 267–282 of a Florentine astrological codex, covering solar and horoscopic degrees, culmination, year-month-day judgments, trine monomoiriai, climacterics, lunar nodes, rulership and times of life, and Hephaestion’s astronomical proem. Later entries treat the themation, the twelve zodiacal parts, trines, exaltations, and planetary configurations by trine, square, and hexagon.
